method: Offline disposable walkthrough of portable demo reducer plus JavaScript syntax check; no browser rendering, requests or production test files.
checks: actual recorded stream validates with three source buttons
authored key-order and escaped Unicode result decodes
unissued source rejected and draft cleared
cancellation clears and ignores late completion
new attempt ignores tagged stale events
withdrawn source rejected before final validation
source withdrawal after validation clears answer and all links
connection failure clears and ignores completion
